INSERT INTO account_narratives (
            account_id,
            organization_id,
            user_id,
            variant,
            content,
            derived_from
         )
         VALUES ($1, $2, NULL, 'BRIEF', $3, $4)
         ON CONFLICT (account_id, organization_id)
             WHERE user_id IS NULL AND variant = 'BRIEF'
         DO UPDATE
             SET content = EXCLUDED.content,
                 derived_from = EXCLUDED.derived_from,
                 updated_at = now()
